---
name: Feature request
about: Describe a new capability or enhancement with background, problem framing, scope, and acceptance criteria.
title: "Feature: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary
Describe the capability to add or improve.

## Background
Explain why this matters now and any relevant surrounding workflow or planning context.

## Problem
Describe the current limitation, friction, or missing capability.

## Proposed Behavior
Describe the desired end state or behavior.

## Scope
- List in-scope changes
- Keep this focused on the intended slice of work

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The intended capability or workflow exists
- [ ] The behavior is concrete enough to verify

## Notes / References
Include grounded references to files, docs, related issues, or constraints when they materially improve the issue.
